split: For test year Y use all entries 2012..Y-1 and outcomes strictly before Y-01-01, follow-up capped at 24 calendar months. Test entries Y with previously verified follow-up coverage through 2026-09-03. Exact audited historical h24 inputs are reused, independently checked against first A/X announcement ledger and chain eligibility.
fixed: 75 unchanged entry-time inputs; 32 trees, depth6, min_leaf10, min_groups5, min_events3 (all causes); q2, shared quantile cutpoints, 25 eligible features per tree, mtry75, 5 thresholds; fixed seeds/company bootstrap; unweighted leaf AJ and equal tree averaging
changed_within_experiment: Only logrankCR cause weights; no outcome-dependent sample weights
changed_relative_to_h12_weight_experimen: Both full available history instead of old calibration holdout and 24 instead of 12 months; do not attribute between-experiment differences solely to horizon
calibration: None; raw two-cause CIF; no clipping, Focal Loss or threshold tuning
comparators: Reuse same-fold 24-month unrestricted and randomForestSRC predictions; verify six refitted equal-weight q2 forests and predictions exactly reproduce frozen historical versions
primary: Average predictions from three fixed seeds, then evaluate; retain all individual seeds. Recompute pooled AP on concatenated time-out forecasts, and also report each year
evaluation: 24-calendar-month IPCW AUC/AP/Brier, mean risk and incidence, Top20/25 independent termination coverage and 3/6-calendar-month lead, probability/reload/reconstruction checks, per-seed and complete 96-tree ensemble complexity and same-reference cross-seed stability at day730
uncertainty: Seed ranges descriptive only; no significance claims, bootstrap selection or extra weight search
resources: Existing two-node Slurm physical CPU pool, NFS, one thread and 4GiB address-space limit per task; no GPU fits
limits: Training termination support 14 and 26, still small
Inherited first-history and financial/industry vintage PIT limits
Announcement origin unchanged; same-day annual reports excluded
No new rule features or rolling observations
Cause weighting is established methodology, not independent novel algorithm
privacy: Company IDs, forecasts, actual cutpoints, forest parameters and full functions remain on private server
